page: Microsoft Azure L160ias_v5 is an isolated virtual machine instance belonging to the Lasv5 server family. It features 160 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture with AMD processors, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 1280.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

For storage-heavy workloads, the L160ias_v5 includes 30718 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external disk options. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or onboard GPU hardware.

Given the high-density local NVMe SSD storage and substantial memory capacity, this instance is designed for large-scale databases, big data analytics, and memory-intensive transactional workloads. The isolated hardware allocation ensures dedicated compute resources, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient choice for enterprise workloads requiring high resource density and strict performance isolation without the overhead of multi-tenant interference.
